decisive_read_only_evidence.name: Geometry-vs-reference interference observation
decisive_read_only_evidence.interpretation: At every observed step of the unchanged v29 trajectory, the controlled-minus-bare guided noise has a negative cosine against the bare positive-minus-negative conditional prediction (the reference-appearance direction). The geometry residual systematically opposes the reference-appearance signal (36% opposed parallel energy). Small sample (2 objects x 3 steps): development observation, not confirmation.

decisive_read_only_evidence.interpretation: The model's training prior is itself biased toward dark warm (brown) tones with one third of objects warm-brown dominant.

decisive_read_only_evidence.name: Generated-output color convergence
decisive_read_only_evidence.source: geotex_matrix/predictions/native_gc3 vs inputs/<uid>/image/000.png, view 0 foreground, 10 bake-cohort objects

numbers.pattern: outputs converge to a bright warm-grey band regardless of reference tone (neutral 0.27 grey -> 0.87 warm; strong warm reference 0.51/0.38/0.24 -> 0.89/0.84/0.81 desaturated)

decisive_read_only_evidence.interpretation: Classic regression toward the training color prior; consistent with the reference-appearance signal being partially overridden.

causal_picture.statement: The geometry residual pathway opposes the reference-appearance signal at every denoising step (negative cosine, ~36% opposed energy). Weakened reference conditioning lets the model fall back to its dark warm training prior (brown repetitive textures). Adapter-scale schedules modulate only the magnitude of this interference, which explains why all six conditions show the failure while remaining metrically close.
supporting: 6/6 negative-cosine observation rows on the unchanged trajectory
Generated outputs converge to the prior band across 10 objects
seed42 view_projection (removing the opposed parallel component) improves source-view FG-PSNR by +2.92 dB, the direction H1 predicts
native_unset (raw correction, no schedule) does not remove the failure: bake unseen PSNR 11.14 vs gt 22.38

falsifiable_predictions: If H1 holds, interaction/view projection conditions should improve reference adherence on source views across seeds; iteration012 completion will directly test this.
If H1 holds, strengthening the reference pathway while keeping the geometry residual fixed should improve tone fidelity but not structure; not tested in this round.
If H1 is false, projection conditions will not separate from native on source-view appearance metrics in the frozen development protocol.
recommended_actions_for_manuscript: Keep the failure reported as-is (frozen outputs unchanged); do not retro-fix.

The diagnosis supports a mechanism sentence in Discussion: cross-object brown failure is consistent with systematic geometry-reference interference plus a warm-biased training prior, not with a projection or baking artifact (source/GT bakes retain reference appearance).

Cite only the frozen evidence: the six interference rows are a development observation; the training-tone and output-convergence statistics are read-only distributional evidence; no causal claim beyond 'consistent with'.
